law: artifact_create{initial} for os.agent.probe/v1 commits `initial` as the artifact's first edit. The canonical pair is genesis pack plus edit-journal spr: the pack stays the JSON text `null` (the value before the first edit) and the journal in the spr carries the initial value as that edit, so a snapshot answers packBytes 4 and a spr that holds the initial JSON text. Creating twice is refused and an omitted initial commits `{}`.
